source.description: Six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet reviewed as one cumulative pencil process before cropping.
source.notes: Honest 2026-05-01 archive study. The sheet must keep one three-quarter cast-iron skillet, one fried egg, exactly two handle rivets, one hanging hole, one pan rim, restrained wear marks, and one broken shadow stable. No countertop scene, utensils, food garnish, text, or final-only structure.

process_strategy: Lock the skillet ellipse, wall depth, handle axis, egg footprint, and shadow first; wrap them with one stable heavy pan silhouette; establish the egg, hardware, and wear before adding graphite and restrained yolk color only to existing forms.

final_elements.name: pan ellipse, wall-depth guide, handle axis, egg reserve, and shadow footprint
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one three-quarter skillet, its long handle, the egg's overlap, and a broken cast-shadow area.

final_elements.name: complete skillet bowl, inner rim, long handle, neck, and hanging hole silhouette
final_elements.description: A heavy cast-iron contour wraps the guides without drawing detail beneath the reserved egg footprint.

final_elements.name: one fried-egg white contour and one round yolk
final_elements.description: One irregular egg white sits inside the pan rim around one round, slightly raised yolk.

final_elements.name: two handle rivets, rim accents, egg-white folds, and restrained pan wear marks
final_elements.description: Countable hardware and a few surface marks clarify the established skillet and egg without adding props.

final_elements.name: cast-iron graphite values, pale-gold yolk pencil, egg shadows, paper highlights, and broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: Directional graphite makes the heavy pan read as dark iron while restrained color and open paper keep the egg light.

rejection_checks: No rim, handle, hanging hole, rivet, egg contour, yolk, fold, wear mark, color area, highlight, or shadow may first appear in the final panel.
The same pan ellipse, wall depth, handle angle, one egg, two rivets, and crop must remain stable in all six panels.
Reject extra eggs, bacon, toast, utensils, stovetop or countertop scenery, glossy photoreal food, smooth digital gradients, text, decorative borders, or vector-like linework.
Every dark pre-final contour must survive in the finish unless it is explicitly a pale erasable construction guide.
